---
title: "Immune Classifier, Step 1: Atlas Data Preparation"
author: "Meite I, Pesce L, Feinstein M, Thorp EB, Lantz C"
date: "2026-03-05"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

#Loading required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Seurat)
    library(dplyr)
    library(yaml)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(here)
})

#Configuration
cat("Phase 1: Data Preparation & Validation\n")

#Load config 
config_path <- "/projects/b1246/Isaac/immune_classifier/config/config.yaml"
if (!file.exists(config_path)) {
    stop("Config file not found at: ", config_path)
}
config <- yaml::read_yaml(config_path)

cat("Configuration loaded\n")

#Load Atlas 
cat("\n[1/5] Loading cardiac immune atlas...\n")

atlas_path <- config$paths$atlas_seurat
if (!file.exists(atlas_path)) { 
    stop("Atlas Seurat object not found at: ", atlas_path)
}

seurat_atlas <- readRDS(atlas_path)

cat(sprintf("Loaded atlas with %s cells and %s genes\n",
            format(ncol(seurat_atlas), big.mark = ","),
            format(nrow(seurat_atlas), big.mark = ",")))

#Verifying Metadata
cat("\n[2/5] Verifying cell type annotations...\n")

cell_type_col <- config$metadata$cell_type_column


# Check column exists
if (!cell_type_col %in% colnames(seurat_atlas@meta.data)) {
    available_cols <- paste(colnames(seurat_atlas@meta.data), collapse = ", ")
    stop(sprintf("Cell type column '%s' not found.\nAvailable columns: %s",
             cell_type_col, available_cols))

}

#Checking for missing labels 
missing_labels  <- sum(is.na(seurat_atlas@meta.data[[cell_type_col]]))
if (missing_labels > 0) {
    warning(sprintf("%d cells have missing cell type labels. These will be removed.", missing_labels))
    cells_to_keep <- !is.na(seurat_atlas@meta.data[[cell_type_col]])
seurat_atlas <- seurat_atlas[, cells_to_keep]
}

#Displaying cell type composition
cell_type_counts <- table(seurat_atlas@meta.data[[cell_type_col]])
cell_type_df <- data.frame(
    Cell_Type = names(cell_type_counts),
    Count = as.numeric(cell_type_counts),
    Percentage = round(100 * as.numeric(cell_type_counts) / ncol(seurat_atlas), 2)
) %>% arrange(desc(Count))

print(cell_type_df, row.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("\n Found %d unique cell types\n", nrow(cell_type_df)))

#Checking rare cell types
cat("\n[3/5] Checking rare cell types...\n")
min_cells_per_type <- 100
rare_types <- cell_type_df %>% filter(Count < min_cells_per_type)

if (nrow(rare_types) >0) {
    cat("\n Warning: cell types with <100 cells may cause issues in train/test/validate split:\n")
    print(rare_types, row.names = FALSE)
}


# Standardize Metadata
cat("\n[4/5] Standardizing metadata...\n")

# Standardized cell type column
seurat_atlas$cell_type <- seurat_atlas@meta.data[[cell_type_col]]

# Add unique cell IDs
seurat_atlas$cell_id <- colnames(seurat_atlas)

# Source flag (atlas vs query)
seurat_atlas$source <- "atlas"

cat("Added standardized metadata columns:\n")
cat(sprintf("cell_type (from %s)\n", cell_type_col))
cat("cell_id (unique identifier)\n")
cat("source (atlas/query flag)\n")

# Save Processed Atlas
cat("\n[5/5] Saving processed atlas...\n")

output_dir <- file.path(config$paths$data_dir, "processed")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

output_path <- file.path(output_dir, "atlas_processed.rds")
saveRDS(seurat_atlas, output_path)

cat(sprintf("Saved to: %s\n", output_path))
cat(sprintf("File size: %.2f MB\n", file.size(output_path) / 1024^2))

```
